overview: On a board at Paul's you found The True Tragedie of Richard Duke of Yorke, as acted by the Earl of Pembroke his servants, printed for Thomas Millington, 1595. You opened it standing. It fell at the one line. You read two pages, yours, mostly, with holes. You did not buy it.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Opened it standing, read, and did not buy it.

parties.name: Michael Drayton
parties.context: At his elbow, not yet speaking.

assets.name: The True Tragedie of Richard Duke of Yorke
assets.disposition: Opened Millington's York book and put it back
